faq.question: Are these tools really free?
faq.answer: Yes! All our Converters tools are completely free to use with no hidden costs, registration requirements, or usage limits. We believe in providing accessible tools for everyone.

faq.question: Do you store my data?
faq.answer: No, all calculations are performed locally in your browser. We don't store, track, or have access to your input data or results. Your privacy is our priority.

faq.question: How accurate are the results?
faq.answer: Our tools use industry-standard formulas and regularly updated data sources to ensure maximum accuracy. For financial tools, we use real-time exchange rates and official data.

faq.question: Do I need to create an account?

faq.question: Can I use these tools on mobile?

tips.title: Mortgage Tips
tips.tip1: A larger down payment reduces your monthly payment and eliminates PMI if 20% or more
tips.tip2: Consider the total cost of homeownership including taxes, insurance, and maintenance
tips.tip3: Shop around for the best interest rates - even 0.25% can save thousands
tips.tip4: Factor in closing costs, which typically range from 2-5% of the home price
tips.tip5: Consider a 15-year mortgage for faster payoff and less total interest
tips.tip6: Make extra principal payments to reduce the total interest paid over time
